metaTags.description: A seasonal Durga Puja under Bharatiya Krishak Samaj, West Bengal, organised with KarmYog for the 21st Century. The Puja names the farmer, shows Integrated Farming, and invites Non-Resident Bengalis to seed village farms. Venue, programme and donations are not claimed.
